decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting requires specialized marine/defence certification and market knowledge distant from the firm's core building and industrial lighting, limiting its absorptive capacity and ability to learn from early results.
General interior lighting builds directly on the firm's existing building-lighting and application-specific knowledge, so it can readily assimilate and improve the product.
The microprismatic pendant luminaire is a flagship aligned with the firm's strategic direction in energy-efficient human-centric lighting, making it a close fit with existing R&D.
Marine searchlights draw on the firm's robust outdoor/transport lighting capabilities and are less distant than naval systems, so the firm can interpret results and improve them.
